items.title: Tanner McKee: I'm ready to make the most of "huge opportunity"
items.text: Tanner McKee fell to No. 3 on the depth chart ahead of Week 1 this season, but he worked his way back to the No. 2 job in time to be the next man up when the Eagles made a surprising announcement on Thursday.

items.title: Bo Nix: I don't know where the disconnect is offensively
items.text: The point of playing football games is to win football games and the Broncos were able to do that against the Seahawks on Thursday night, but the result didn't shield their quarterback Bo Nix from some harsh criticism after the game.

items.title: Broncos won despite totaling just 32 yards on their last 10 possessions
items.text: The Broncos' offense was stunningly bad for most of Thursday night's game.

items.title: Police continue to withhold the Josh Jacobs video

items.title: Troy Aikman: It seems like ESPN is going to go in a different direction
items.text: Hall of Fame quarterback and ESPN/ABC Monday Night Football analyst Troy Aikman made some waves on Thursday morning by creating the clear impression that he's planning to leave after his current contract expires, after Super Bowl LXI.
